/hard-engineer.title: Syncere
/hard-engineer.description: The biggest upgrade to light since the LED.
p: We're looking for a Robotics Hardware Engineer to design and build Lume. You'll lead mechanical development from early concept and prototyping to CAD for manufacturing. This includes designing robotic arms, integrating actuators and sensors, testing in our lab, and working closely with our design and founding teams to bring an entirely new robotic form factor into homes.

• Design and prototype an entirely new robotic form factor (furniture that becomes a robot)• Own mechanical subsystem development (kinematics, actuation, enclosures) for robotic manipulators• Translate product vision into manufacturable CAD• Integrate hardware, electronics, and motor control software• Lead DFM and support early-stage manufacturing planning (supplier onboarding, scaling)• Drive iteration cycles: build, test, debug, repeat• Work flexible shifts including nights/weekends as needed

• Mechanical generalist with a robotics edge (mechanical/mechatronics engineering)• Strong hands-on experience with 3D printing, machining, rapid fabrication• Values good design and consumer sensibility in robotics• Excellent in CAD, Structural FEA, GD&T• Experience with 6DOF arms, kinematics/dynamics, simulation and control• Comfortable with electronic skills (motors, sensors, harnesses, power supplies)• Can lead work with minimal guidance in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment• Communicates clearly and concisely• Must speak fluent technical English and Mandarin• From a top 20 global university

• Obsessed with thoughtful design; can point to a product that “sparks joy” and say why• Loves good food and has a strong opinion on the best burrito within 2 miles (we do team meals)• Someone with a chip on their shoulder who gets a thrill from proving doubters wrong• Low-ego collaborator who gives and receives kind, actionable feedback• Brings a hobby to share (photography, music, sports, etc.)• Healthy meme game; can explain a research paper and a meme in the same breath

/elec-engineer.title: Syncere
/elec-engineer.description: The biggest upgrade to light since the LED.
p: We're looking for a Robotics Electrical Engineer to design and build the electrical systems behind Lume. You'll own electrical development from early prototypes through production-ready designs. This includes wire harnesses, power systems, battery and charging architecture, custom PCBs, system integration, and working closely with our mechanical, software, and design teams to bring an entirely new robotic form factor into homes.

• Design and prototype electrical systems for a new category of home robotics• Own system-level electrical architecture including power distribution, safety, grounding, and signal integrity• Design wire harnesses, connector schemes, and interconnect systems for moving robotic assemblies• Develop custom PCBs for motor control, sensing, power management, and embedded subsystems• Build and validate battery systems, charging systems, and power electronics for consumer robotic products• Integrate motors, sensors, actuators, embedded controllers, and higher-level software systems• Support rapid prototyping in the lab: bring-up, debugging, rework, validation, and iteration• Work with suppliers and manufacturers to move designs toward EVT/DVT/PVT and mass production readiness• Drive DFM/DFT decisions and support test fixture development and manufacturing processes• Work flexible shifts including nights/weekends as needed

• Strong electrical engineering fundamentals in robotics, embedded systems, or electromechanical products• Hands-on experience with wiring, harnessing, PCB bring-up, debugging, and bench testing• Experience designing custom PCBs and working with common tools for schematic capture and layout• Familiarity with batteries, BMS, charging, DC power systems, and safe power architecture• Comfortable integrating motors, encoders, sensors, microcontrollers, and communication buses• Able to debug across the stack: electrical, firmware, mechanical integration, and system behavior• Understands how to design for reliability, manufacturability, serviceability, and safety• Can lead work with minimal guidance in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment• Communicates clearly and concisely• Mandarin speaking is a plus (to interact with our Chinese suppliers)• From a top 20 global university

• Experience with robotics, consumer electronics, EV systems, or battery-powered hardware products• Familiarity with EMI/EMC, certification, compliance, and production test strategy• Experience working directly with overseas vendors, CM/ODM partners, or NPI teams• Obsessed with thoughtful design; cares about how great hardware feels, not just how it functions• Low-ego collaborator who gives and receives kind, actionable feedback• Brings intensity, taste, and a bias toward building fast

• Full time and internship (6-month minimum contract) options available• In person, M–F, 9–6.• Health benefits included, company holidays, team meals, sick leave, etc.• Preference given to candidates who can start immediately

/research-scientist.title: Syncere
/research-scientist.description: The biggest upgrade to light since the LED.
p: We're looking for a Research Scientist to architect and deploy the machine learning models behind our laundry-folding robot. You'll own the full autonomy stack: from training manipulation models (imitation learning, RL, VLA) to deploying them on real robots in the home. You'll also extend cutting-edge research, refine our data pipelines, and collaborate closely with engineering to bring reliable, in-home robotics to life.

• Train, deploy, and maintain laundry folding models on physical systems• Build autonomy for manipulation tasks using imitation learning, RL, VLA, and world models• Develop our teleoperation/data collection stack and simulation pipelines• Reproduce and extend cutting-edge robotics research• Test, debug, and iterate on real robots in our lab• Collaborate closely with our engineering team• Work flexible shifts including nights/weekends as needed

• Current PhD students, postdoc, or recent PhD grad in robotics, ML, or a related field• Publications at top conferences/journals (NeurIPS, ICRA, RSS, CoRL, T-RO, Science, Nature, etc.)• Deep knowledge of robot learning: imitation learning, RL, and classical control• Experience deploying models on physical systems, especially for manipulation tasks like folding• Can lead work with minimal guidance in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment• Values good design and consumer sensibility in robotics• Communicates clearly and concisely• From a top 20 global university
